author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

observed.provenance_of_these_facts: the PRE capture fields are measured from the artefact on disk; the stage trace and refusal are the structured result the run itself returned

ATTEMPT_001_PRE_CAPTURE.label: PRE_ARM_A
ATTEMPT_001_PRE_CAPTURE.never_reused: this capture belongs to attempt 001. A repaired attempt receives a new identity and a new capture; recycling this one would erase the evidence that the failed attempt entered the lifecycle under a valid environment

NOT_A_NAVIGATION_OUTCOME: no episode ran, so this attempt has no success, no failure, no goal distance and no cross-track. Recording success=false would assert a completed trial that never began

root_technical_failure.old_dataflow: IsaacRuntimeAdapter.initialise created and entered an IsaacApp. build_collector then called Collector(out_dir, collect_config, self._app.config, M3PRO) -- correct for the `sim: SimConfig` parameter, and not an application. Collector.run is the only place that assigned self._app, via `with IsaacApp(self.sim) as app`, and the adapter never calls run: an arm is one episode under a frozen route, not a collection loop. So load_scene reached Collector.open_scene with self._app still None
root_technical_failure.corrected_dataflow: build_collector passes isaac_app=self._app, handing over the object it owns rather than describing it. open_scene refuses with a named category instead of a bare assert, and run refuses to create a second application when one was handed in
root_technical_failure.why_every_earlier_gate_passed: every earlier readiness level was measured through the rehearsal adapter, whose build_collector returns a dictionary and asserts nothing. The seam between two individually correct components was never exercised
